subject: Civic Education
competence: Explains the duties and responsibilities of public service institutions.
unique_learning_outcome: Explains the duties and responsibilities of public service institutions.
Expresses views accepting the fact that fulfillment of duties and responsibilities of the public services institutions bring about the welfare of human beings.
Explains the importance of providing efficient service of the officers of public services identifying the need.
the_entrance: Understanding the importance of public service institutions in our daily lives.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Introduce the concept of public service institutions and their roles.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students will take notes on the importance of public service institutions.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Facilitate a group discussion on the duties and responsibilities of public service institutions.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students will participate in a group discussion and share their views.
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Monitoring group progress and correcting misconceptions

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Guide students to express their views on the importance of public service institutions.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students will present their views and share recorded observations.

summary: Recap of the importance of public service institutions and their roles.
assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: Summative check through a class discussion
post_activity: Concrete homework assignment on the importance of public service institutions
information_sources: National Institute of Education (NIE) Teacher Instructional Guide
